interface_decision.semantic_role: Lagrange divisibility and the order-one subgroup corollary
interface_decision.litex_form: two named theorems over the existing subgroup and coset interfaces

proof_spine: Use the explicit coset-coordinate bijection to identify |G| with |G/H| * |H|.
Witness divisibility by the finite quotient size.
A finite subgroup of size one cannot contain an element different from the identity.

blocks.name: subgroup_order_divides_group_order
blocks.accepted_litex:
thm subgroup_order_divides_group_order:
    ? forall G nonempty_set, group &group::Group<G>, H power_set(G):
        $subgroup::is_subgroup(G, group, H)
        $is_finite_set(G)
        $is_finite_set(H)
        =>:
            $group::divides(finite_set_size(H), finite_set_size(G))
    release thm cosets::left_coset_space_finite(G, group, H)
    release thm cosets::left_coset_forward_bijective(G, group, H)
    $is_finite_set(cart(\cosets::quotient_group_carrier<G, group>(H), H))
    finite_set_size(G) = finite_set_size(cart(\cosets::quotient_group_carrier<G, group>(H), H))
    finite_set_size(cart(\cosets::quotient_group_carrier<G, group>(H), H)) = finite_set_size(\cosets::quotient_group_carrier<G, group>(H)) * finite_set_size(H)
    finite_set_size(G) = finite_set_size(\cosets::quotient_group_carrier<G, group>(H)) * finite_set_size(H) = finite_set_size(H) * finite_set_size(\cosets::quotient_group_carrier<G, group>(H))
    witness $group::divides(finite_set_size(H), finite_set_size(G)) from finite_set_size(\cosets::quotient_group_carrier<G, group>(H)):
        finite_set_size(G) = finite_set_size(H) * finite_set_size(\cosets::quotient_group_carrier<G, group>(H))

blocks.name: subgroup_eq_bottom_iff_order_one_forward
blocks.accepted_litex:
thm subgroup_eq_bottom_iff_order_one_forward:
    ? forall G nonempty_set, group &group::Group<G>, H power_set(G):
        $subgroup::is_subgroup(G, group, H)
        $is_finite_set(H)
        finite_set_size(H) = 1
        =>:
            H = {group.one}
    claim:
        ? forall x H:
            x = group.one
        by cases:
            ? x = group.one
            case x = group.one:
                x = group.one
            case x != group.one:
                group.one $in H
                claim:
                    ? group.one != x
                    by contra:
                        ? group.one != x
                        group.one = x
                        x = group.one
                        impossible x != group.one
                claim:
                    ? forall y {group.one, x}:
                        y $in H
                    by cases:
                        ? y $in H
                        case y = group.one:
                            y = group.one
                            group.one $in H
                            y $in H
                        case y = x:
                            y = x
                            x $in H
                            y $in H
                {group.one, x} $subset H
                finite_set_size({group.one, x}) = 2
                finite_set_size({group.one, x}) <= finite_set_size(H)
                2 <= 1
                impossible 2 <= 1
    by extension:
        ? H = {group.one}
        claim:
            ? forall x H:
                x $in {group.one}
            x = group.one
            x $in {group.one}
        claim:
            ? forall x {group.one}:
                x $in H
            x = group.one
            group.one $in H
            x $in H
